quarterly_data.quarter: TFME investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: in H1 2026 it pushed renovation and expansion of its production bases - Chongchuan plant, Tongfu Tongke, Xiamen Tongfu, TF-AMD Suzhou and TF-AMD Penang - completing about 3.9 wan (ten-thousand) square meters of renovated area cumulatively, with about 14 wan (ten-thousand) square meters of projects under construction; new capacity from its private-placement projects will be released in line with market demand. Some of its orders are 'relatively sufficient', and packaging and test prices are negotiated with customers considering supply and demand, costs and raw material prices.
quarterly_data.figure: about 3.9 wan (ten-thousand) square meters renovated; about 14 wan (ten-thousand) square meters under construction

quarterly_data.quarter: TFME investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: in H1 2026 it focused on 2D+ multi-dimensional stacked advanced packaging around its VISIONS platform, integrating silicon interposer, vertical stacking and embedded multi-bridge solutions for multi-chiplet heterogeneous integration; TSV pitch keeps shrinking and the company claims industry-leading thermal and warpage control. It will keep watching and evaluating the business model for silicon interposers.

quarterly_data.quarter: TFME investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: in memory packaging it has mastered 3D NAND multi-die stacking, 3Ds 2/4H strip-level DRAM and PoP technology, and has the basis of LPDDR 12DP engineering capability.
